name: claude-rice-v7-mac
description: v7 on macOS: six right-hand panes as tabs (Bridge, flightdeck, filetree, cockpit, paneline, cctop) and prismantis on the v2 Ember rice, with Ghostty and fish in place of Windows Terminal and PowerShell.

scripts.setup: node tools/mac.mjs apply ember && node tools/mods.mjs install && node tools/rice.mjs apply ember
scripts.revert: node tools/rice.mjs revert && node tools/mac.mjs revert
scripts.status: node tools/mac.mjs status && node tools/rice.mjs status && node tools/mods.mjs status
